your_book:
Wednesday was a tale of two tapes for Jaleel's book. Pharma lifted the session — AstraZeneca surged +4.0% and Gilead jumped +3.8%, with Novartis adding +3.1% and Vertex +2.7%, providing meaningful ballast across the healthcare cluster. ZTS contributed a quiet +1.3% and Adobe recovered +1.9%, all of which softened what was otherwise a drag from the tech and speculative corners. Against that, NVDA shed -3.2% and Broadcom -3.1% on the same macro narrative: rate-hike expectations resurfacing on inflation and energy concerns, raising questions about AI-capex durability — exactly the overhang flagged in the risk register. The book's overall unrealized position sits at -3.1%, so there is no cushion to absorb further macro-driven re-ratings in the chip names.

The clearest thesis drift remains Rocket Lab, down -7.85% today and now -24.5% in the red — while its verdict sits at AVOID and its QARP scores a low 40.1, the position continues to occupy a 6.6% weight. Price and thesis have been moving in opposite directions for some time; that divergence now demands a frank answer. BSX is the other uncomfortable name: an elevated risk flag (guidance slashed, flat through Q3), a -12.3% unrealized loss, and earnings due October 28 — that's a live catalyst with little room for another disappointment. LULU at -26.4% unrealized with a guidance-cut flag and comps in a fifth straight decline rounds out the drift stories; the STRONG BUY verdict looks increasingly strained against the fundamentals.

Looking ahead to Thursday, October 15, the semiconductor complex bears watching closely — if rate-hike rhetoric firms overnight, NVDA and AVGO could face another leg down, and their combined weight is meaningful. Abbott (next catalyst October 21) and the broad pharma cluster (drug-pricing policy event October 22) are the near-term scheduled risks to track.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated at 6.6% weight, down -7.85% today and -24.5% unrealized
attention.note: The verdict is AVOID and the QARP is the lowest in the book at 40.1 — at 6.6% weight this is the most glaring misalignment between conviction and position size, and today's move widens the gap further.

attention.headline: Guidance-slashed name with earnings October 28 and -12.3% loss already on the books
attention.note: Management guided flat through Q3, the stock is already well underwater, and the next catalyst is less than two weeks away — the risk/reward of carrying full weight into that print needs an explicit decision.

attention.headline: Rate-hike narrative hammered chips -3.2% today; AI-capex doubt compounds export-control overhang
attention.note: Today's headline risk — higher borrowing costs pressuring capex and demand — layers directly on top of the existing export-controls flag, making NVDA the book's most crowded risk story ahead of its November 17 catalyst.

attention.headline: STRONG BUY verdict increasingly hard to defend against -26.4% loss and fifth straight Americas comp decline
attention.note: With tariffs gutting margins, China stalled, and the next catalyst not until December 9, the gap between the model's conviction and the operating reality is wide enough to warrant a thesis re-check now rather than then.
